notes: house() treats this type as a large 2.5 x 2 building and paints the same wall, door, window and roof colours as a cottage; only the footprint differs.
The tile renderer draws a separate civic-building case (world.js) with a window grid; its '#d3c4a6' wall belongs to the terrain 'building' tile, not to this object.
